title: FCH micelles from noise grow a self-made shell layer that holds a self-made cargo, and both pass to daughters at fission (SIBWD, fch-bilayer)
summary: Fed FCH micelles (eta1=4, eta2=5, amphiphile feed 5e-4) make two species where amphiphile is dense: a shell species q that adsorbs at intermediate amphiphile density (Scharfetter-Gummel drift in -chi_q exp(-((u+0.6)/0.8)^2)) and so forms a ring at each micelle surface (rim/core 10-12, rim/outside 5, >= 97% of individuals membrane-like), and a cargo c whose diffusivity is Dc exp(-8 q) (harmonic face mean), with no partitioning. From white noise ~30 micelles form by t~16 and divide 18-26 times per seed (generation 2-3, <= 1 merge). The shell holds the cargo at 14-36x the outside after t~120 (97-100% of bodies >= 2x); without the gate (beta=0) the contrast is 1.1x, and with the same q made but not adsorbed (chi_q=0, no layer: q floods the medium) 2.4-6.7x. At fission the ring pinches into a figure-8 and each daughter closes its own ring; the neck leaks, so daughters start at ~10-15x (parent ~45x) and refill. Holds at 1.5x resolution (ring rim/core 9.9, contrast 19-27x).

claims.statement: On 3/3 seeds, micelles that form from white noise each carry a ring of a self-made shell species at their surface and hold a self-made cargo inside it at 14-36x the outside; they grow on the amphiphile feed and divide repeatedly (18-26 persistent splits, generation 2-3), each daughter closing its own shell ring and keeping cargo at ~10x or more; removing the gate (beta=0) removes the contrast (1.1x) and removing the adsorption that makes the layer (chi_q=0) cuts it to 2.4-6.7x.
claims.track: seed 1, the micelle in row 3 of fission_strips_seed1.png (t=348-392): shell ring and cargo ~42x, elongates, the ring pinches into a figure-8 and two daughters with their own rings keep cargo at 10-15x

controls_run.W: pack_beta0/ (seeds 0, 1: gate off, identical bodies and shell, cargo contrast 1.1x) and pack_res15/ (1.5x finer grid: contrast 19-27x, ring rim/core 9.9)
controls_run.B: pack_chiq0/ (seeds 0, 1: q made but no adsorption drift: no ring, rim/core 0.93, and containment falls to 2.4-6.7x, so the layer does the containing)

claims.bd_control: not run as a Laplacian twin; the beta=0 arm (cargo by plain diffusion through identical bodies) is the matched control for containment.

limits: The shell and the cargo are passive: they do not act back on the amphiphile, so growth and division are those of fed FCH micelles (by the open amphiphile feed, in synchronized waves) whatever the contents, and nothing is selected. The shell is a quasi-equilibrium adsorption layer set by a chosen potential of u (as phase_membrane's wall drift), 2-3 px wide at dx 0.5. Fission leaks cargo at the neck. A few freshly nucleated bodies (<= 3%) hold < 2x.
